tasks.title: E10 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E10 (NASA registry and evidence database). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E10.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E10/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E10/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Pure evidence models, validation schemas and public ports
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md first, then every reads entry. This is a fresh-session brief. Edit only owned_paths, including tests. The implementation trees are absent at planning time; recheck the tree and ownership before creating files. Do not edit shared contracts, configuration, toolchain, another epic, another task, the design, requests or AI-USE-LOG.md. Return missing shared declarations to the coordinator. Pending requests are not implementation authority. Never invent a provider, DTO field, table, operation identifier, handler/version or public endpoint to close a gap. Required provider shapes must be accepted and published before the dependent code starts. Safe unavailable behavior is not complete acceptance.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory, 5.2 injected Clock and correction-aware TimeInput, 5.3 opaque string mission versions, 5.4 Quantity/UCUM, 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and ErrorEnvelope, 5.6 validated snapshot release pins, 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot and replication declarations, 5.8 CommandPolicy/CommandIdentity/CommandIntents/ResultVisibility, 5.9 reference-only audit, 5.10 scheduler and 5.10.1 task runner, 5.11 bounded HubSettings and 5.12 ModuleRegistry. Parse generated models only at API/adapter boundaries and map them to pure domain/kernel types. Domain imports only its own domain, kernel and allowed standard library. No replacement transaction, audit, queue, retry, clock, config loader or deduplication store. SYSTEM 6 supplies uv --project hub, generated models and generated import contracts; SYSTEM 8.1/8.2/8.3 fixes ownership, guidance and privacy. Use actual kernel.testing only for component tests against declared protocols; never create a fake provider contract. End-to-end acceptance uses real hub services and SQLite, with documented fakes only for optional external processes. No test-only production branch, runtime sample fallback, hardcoded domain content, private logs or fabricated missing values.

Tests come first on critical paths and carry the exact T-E10 and R/V/D/invariant traces below. Fixtures are explicit under fixtures/knowledge or eval/scenarios/e10; clinical text comes from pinned sources/configuration, with independently checked golden expectations. No network acquisition; Q24/Q26 require reusing saved sources and forbid bulk fetches. All applicable AGENTS section 6 faults must be exercised. Run the exact gates; do not skip, xfail or filter away missing acceptance. Complete means the owned tests/type/lint/import gates pass and required integration is real, not merely disabled. Whole-epic completion additionally needs T6, independent review, green CI and coordinator AI-use rows. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen used as a dash.

Build only E10 sections 3, 4.1/4.2 public declarations and 8/11 validation definitions. Leave input acquisition/registry assembly to T2, catalog persistence and bundle execution to T3, release persistence to T4, retrieval/API to T5, and registration/CLI/end-to-end wiring to T6. T1 is the sole editor of E10 domain types, schemas and application/ports.py. Freeze those declarations before dependent tasks run. Where R-E10-14/16/17/19/21 leaves the shape incomplete, obtain the author's exact accepted declaration first; do not guess it from the command table. Pure independent models may proceed while these integrations wait.

Define the named models exactly from E10 3: RegistrySnapshot, Condition, ConditionResolution, Source, SourceSummary, DocumentVersion, CaptureAssessment, Extraction, PassageArtifact, ReleaseMembership, PathwayCard and ReviewExport. Use SYSTEM IdFactory derivation inputs from E10:138-143, including format/text/page-map hashes in extraction identity. Keep original spans immutable and membership/license/review metadata release-specific. Approval is per immutable target, extraction/span and purpose. Preserve fail/revoked review-head dominance, extractor/reviewer separation, complete receipt references, independently reviewed discrepancy relations, and later clinical review without mutating old releases. Q1/Q18 makes clinical_review a label, not a clinical-sign-off gate; draft, withdrawn, unknown-purpose or actual SIM-only content never becomes operational guidance. Q2 NASA full text versus documented permission versus metadata-only remains enforced, with no text or vector from metadata-only sources.

Use all four EvidencePassage allowed_uses values from its opened schema: risk_context, patient_instruction, routine_basis, limit_basis. PathwayCard has the separate design purpose/eligibility semantics; do not add pathway_card to that wire enum. Copy EvidenceQueryPort signatures at E10:302-315, ResearchCatalogPort at :382-405, ReleaseAdminPort at :407-418, SourceRegistryPort at :119, ConditionRegistryPort reads at :120/:337 and ReleaseBuilderPort.build at :123. Preserve ApprovedRead's Eligible, NotApprovedForUse, InReleaseHistory, NotInRelease and ReleaseUnavailable results, and SearchResult's Hits, NoMatch, NoActiveRelease, ReleaseUnavailable, IndexUnavailable and QueryRejected. No None shortcut or active-release substitution. Form/content adapter contracts remain subject to R-E10-17. Review comment 1: import the canonical MissionClock with version:str|None from SYSTEM 5.3; never define or coerce an integer version. Review comment 2: CommandIdentity has no durable field; use existing kernel types, not a local substitute. T6 registers the operations/handlers after the coordinator supplies their exact names.

Write tests first in test_review.py for T-E10-08/09/21/23/24/34/49/57/59, traced to I3/I4, R21 and V24: capture ceiling before extraction, per-use independence, clinical label independence, unsupported/contradicted claims, incomplete heads, exact hashes and non-NASA rights. test_passage.py owns pure T-E10-12/22/26/27/46, traced to E10-03/I2/V22: Unicode spans/page maps, changed extraction identity, tables with headers, explicit oversized-table rejection, exact symbols/units and inert embedded instructions. test_bounds.py owns T-E10-07/55 and pure T-E10-60, traced to E10-02/I8/C5/C20: URL idempotence without merging meaningful differences, every parser's zero/negative/empty/max/over-limit cases, bounded JSON/archive declarations, nonfinite/wrong-dimension vectors and generated ID patterns. Include the opaque clock-version regression. Construct shared fixtures from pinned public content only; fixture manifest records provenance and explicit profile. Runtime schemas/policy carry provenance, never clinical fixtures.

Failures here are malformed, partial, conflicting, missing or corrupt inputs; reject atomically as pure results/typed errors. There are no domain I/O calls, write/crash boundaries, external queues or private stores in this task. Persistence and process faults belong to T3/T4/T6. Done: domain properties and independent golden eligibility cases pass, schemas validate through owned tests, exact ports are frozen with every unresolved integration explicitly unavailable, and no shared type is handwritten. This is a prerequisite contract handoff, not permission for T2-T6 to invent the remaining coordinator decisions.
